notes.title: Update Released
notes.content:
The latest updated has these new features: 
Ability to re-orient the table within your physical space 
Ability to disable the music/soundEffects 
Ball Size can be adjusted in settings 
Slow motion can be adjusted in settings 
Improved physics (more accurate collisions between ball & paddle)
